title: Six-Villa Pool Estate 500 m from Choeng Mon Beach, Sold as One
blurb: A rare turnkey portfolio of six fully independent pool villas on a private estate road, about 500 m from Choeng Mon Beach — three contemporary three-bedroom villas with covered garages and three garden villas with two living blocks each. Ready to operate as a rental portfolio or a boutique resort.
detail:
Multi-villa estates of this size almost never come to market on Koh Samui. This one is offered complete: six independent villas, built and furnished, on a private estate road roughly 500 m from Choeng Mon Beach — the island's calm, family-friendly north-east shore, ten minutes from Samui International Airport and five from Plai Laem.

The estate is built in two complementary types. Three of the villas are contemporary two-storey homes with three en-suite bedrooms, a private pool, a covered garage and generous terraces — flat rooflines, timber-slatted facades and floor-to-ceiling glazing that opens the living room to the pool. The other three are garden villas, each set in a large private garden and planned as two independent living blocks, which suits families travelling together, wellness retreats and longer stays.

Interiors are bright and easy: high ceilings, natural light, open kitchens with built-in appliances, indoor dining, air conditioning, custom furniture and fibre internet, with laundry, storage and staff space provided. Outside, each villa has its own pool, pool deck, outdoor dining terrace and tropical planting, so guests get real privacy even within the estate.

Held leasehold on chanote title, with government electricity and deep-well water, the estate is ready to earn from the first day. It can be let villa by villa, marketed as a single retreat for large groups, or reworked as a boutique resort — a scale and location that is hard to assemble again.
